name: PLURALISTIC BEHAVIOR SUITE (PBSUITE)
description: PBSUITE is a dynamic evaluation suite designed to assess LLMs' adherence to pluralistic alignment specifications in multi-turn interactive conversations. It includes a dataset of 300 realistic behavioral policies from 30 industries and a framework for stress-testing compliance under adversarial conditions.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the alignment/safety literature, so it is not yet widely established as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Highlights challenges in multi-turn adversarial interactions; focuses on pluralistic alignment and behavioral policy adherence.
